Dallas Detox Center Offers Addiction Treatment near Arlington, TX

blocks.html:
Dallas Detox Center is a drug and alcohol detox center in Arlington, Texas. Our luxurious inpatient treatment program can provide you with a continuum of care that includes detoxification, inpatient rehab care, and alumni support services.

Dallas Detox Center provides treatment for individuals abusing various substances, including heroin, benzodiazepines, alcohol, and cocaine. In our detoxification program, you will receive medical supervision around the clock to ensure that you move through this process as safely as possible. Our medical staff will monitor you for known health concerns and work with you to ease some of the discomforts you experience during this time.

Once you have completed your detox program, you can then continue to our inpatient rehab program, which can vary from 30 to 90 days, depending on your unique needs. Individuals that we work with who are living with other mental health concerns including anxiety, depression, and trauma, may find themselves in treatment longer than individuals who are receiving only addiction treatment. Our treatment program uses a combination of group therapy, individual therapy, and educational sessions. We provide you with a holistic treatment experience that will explore how your addiction impacted your life, and identify different ways that we can improve the consequences you experienced.

We recognize that your recovery journey doesn’t end when you complete your inpatient program. We offer alumni services, including check-in, phone calls, and visits, and will work with you to readmit you if you need treatment services down the road.

If you have been struggling with drugs and alcohol and are considering getting help, take a moment to recognize how far you have come. You have survived active addiction and are on the cusp of getting the help you deserve. Many individuals who struggle with alcohol and drugs do not get the opportunity to ask for the help that they have now. Take some time today to speak with a Dallas Detox Center representative by calling (817)904-2197 today.
